cond_0001.intro: In this role as a Quality Engineer, you will be responsible for supporting several products within a given program area/market segment. You'll work in an Integrated Project Team environment and will be responsible for coordinating all aspects of quality for the team.
cond_0001.responsibilities:
Provide oversight of all aspects of product quality relating to assigned programs including: inspection methods, data collection, data analysis, non-conforming material dispositions, and product/process quality assurance.
Investigate and produce corrective actions meeting on-time submittal and acceptable quality standards for root cause analysis and preventative action effectiveness.
Ensure on-time implementation of corrective actions and verification of preventative action effectiveness.
Coordinate and lead Material Review Board activities.
Gather and report results from weekly and monthly quality metrics for all assigned programs.
Perform continuous improvement activities to improve departmental and/or program capability in areas of inspection, cost of quality, quantitative process control or general process efficiency.
Interface with DCMA, ISEA and other customer representatives as required.
cond_0001.requirements:
Minimum Requirements
Bachelor's Degree in Engineering or related technical degree, and two (2) years related Quality Assurance experience, or the overall equivalent experience.
Quality experience in a manufacturing or engineering environment.
Experience operating in an organization with government quality oversight.
Familiarity with FAR/DFAR requirements.
Familiarity and working knowledge of ISO9001 and AS9100 standards.
Current or ability to obtain security clearance.
Strength in planning and time management.
Excellent communication and interpersonal skills.
Preferred Requirements
Experience with Lean and process improvement tools/methods.
Experience with Six Sigma, SPC techniques and PFMEA.
Prior experience with the management of a Quality Management System.

Support oversight of all aspects of product quality for assigned programs, including inspection methods, data collection, data analysis, non-conforming material dispositions, and product/process quality assurance.
Coordinate with the team to investigate and produce corrective actions that meet on-time submittal and acceptable quality standards for root cause analysis and preventative action effectiveness.
Help ensure on-time implementation of corrective actions and work with relevant stakeholders to verify preventative action effectiveness.
Coordinate and facilitate Material Review Board activities.
Gather and share results from weekly and monthly quality metrics for all assigned programs.
Collaborate on continuous improvement activities to improve departmental and/or program capability in areas of inspection, cost of quality, quantitative process control, or general process efficiency.
Work alongside DCMA, ISEA, and other customer representatives as required.
cond_0090.requirements:
Experience operating in an organization with government quality oversight.
Familiarity with FAR/DFAR requirements.
Familiarity and working knowledge of ISO9001 and AS9100 standards.
Current or ability to obtain security clearance.
Experience with Lean and process improvement tools/methods.
Experience with Six Sigma, SPC techniques and PFMEA.
Typically requires a Bachelor's Degree in Engineering or related technical degree, and two (2) years related Quality Assurance experience, or the overall equivalent experience.
Quality experience in a manufacturing or engineering environment.
Prior experience with the management of a Quality Management System.
Familiarity and working knowledge of the ISO 9001 standard.
Strength in planning and time management.
Excellent communication and interpersonal skills.

Familiarity with FAR/DFAR requirements.
Current security clearance, or willingness to obtain one.

Work alongside the team to provide oversight of all aspects of product quality for assigned programs, including inspection methods, data collection, data analysis, non-conforming material dispositions, and product/process quality assurance.
Collaborate on investigating and producing corrective actions that meet on-time submittal and acceptable quality standards for root cause analysis and preventative action effectiveness.
Help ensure on-time implementation of corrective actions and support verification of preventative action effectiveness.
Coordinate and facilitate Material Review Board activities.
Gather and share results from weekly and monthly quality metrics for all assigned programs.
Work with the team on continuous improvement activities to improve departmental and/or program capability in areas of inspection, cost of quality, quantitative process control, or general process efficiency.
Coordinate with DCMA, ISEA, and other customer representatives as required.
cond_0243.requirements:
Minimum Requirements
Bachelor's Degree in Engineering or related technical degree, and two (2) years of related Quality Assurance experience, or the overall equivalent experience.
Quality experience in a manufacturing or engineering environment.
Experience operating in an organization with government quality oversight.
Familiarity with FAR/DFAR requirements.
Familiarity and working knowledge of ISO 9001 and AS9100 standards.
Current or ability to obtain security clearance.
Strong planning and time management skills.
Excellent communication and interpersonal skills.
Preferred Requirements
Prior experience with the management of a Quality Management System.
Experience with Lean and process improvement tools/methods.
Experience with Six Sigma, SPC techniques, and PFMEA.

cond_0281.responsibilities:

Ensure on-time implementation of corrective actions and verification of preventative action effectiveness.
Coordinate and lead Material Review Board activities.

Perform continuous improvement activities to improve departmental and/or program capability in areas of inspection, cost of quality, quantitative process control or general process efficiency.

cond_0281.requirements:
Demonstrated expertise operating in an organization with government quality oversight.
Proficiency in FAR/DFAR requirements.
Advanced knowledge of ISO9001 and AS9100 standards.
Current or ability to obtain security clearance.
Proven track record with Lean and process improvement tools/methods.
Expertise in Six Sigma, SPC techniques and PFMEA.
Bachelor's Degree in Engineering or related technical degree required; advanced degree strongly preferred. Minimum two (2) years of demonstrated Quality Assurance experience, or the overall equivalent experience.
Substantial quality experience in a manufacturing or engineering environment.
Proven track record in the management of a Quality Management System.
Deep knowledge of the ISO 9001 standard.
Strong command of planning and time management.
Exceptional communication and interpersonal skills.

Provide oversight of all aspects of product quality relating to assigned programs including: inspection methods, data collection, data analysis, non-conforming material dispositions, and product/process quality assurance.
Investigate and produce corrective actions meeting on-time submittal and acceptable quality standards for root cause analysis and preventative action effectiveness.
Ensure on-time implementation of corrective actions and verification of preventative action effectiveness.
Coordinate and lead Material Review Board activities.
Gather and report results from weekly and monthly quality metrics for all assigned programs.
Perform continuous improvement activities to improve departmental and/or program capability in areas of inspection, cost of quality, quantitative process control or general process efficiency.
Interface with DCMA, ISEA and other customer representatives as required.
cond_0407.requirements:
Demonstrated expertise operating in an organization with government quality oversight.
Proficiency in FAR/DFAR requirements.
Advanced knowledge of ISO9001 and AS9100 standards.
Current or ability to obtain security clearance.
Proven track record with Lean and process improvement tools/methods.
Expertise in Six Sigma, SPC techniques and PFMEA.
Bachelor's Degree in Engineering or related technical degree required; advanced degree strongly preferred. Minimum two (2) years of demonstrated Quality Assurance experience, or the overall equivalent experience.
Substantial quality experience in a manufacturing or engineering environment.
Proven track record in the management of a Quality Management System.
Deep knowledge of the ISO 9001 standard.
Strong command of planning and time management.
Exceptional communication and interpersonal skills.
cond_0407.encouragement_text: Important: Even if you do not meet all of the qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply.
cond_0407.values: We value excellence, focus, and the ability to produce strong outcomes. We believe organizations succeed when they hold themselves to a high bar.

cond_0465.intro: In this role as a Quality Engineer, you will be responsible for supporting several products within a given program area/market segment. You'll work in an Integrated Project Team environment and will regularly coordinate with team members across all aspects of quality, staying in close contact with stakeholders throughout each program.
cond_0465.responsibilities:
Provide oversight of all aspects of product quality relating to assigned programs including: inspection methods, data collection, data analysis, non-conforming material dispositions, and product/process quality assurance.
Investigate and produce corrective actions meeting on-time submittal and acceptable quality standards for root cause analysis and preventative action effectiveness.
Ensure on-time implementation of corrective actions and verification of preventative action effectiveness.
Coordinate and lead Material Review Board activities, actively bringing together the right people to reach timely decisions.
Gather and report results from weekly and monthly quality metrics for all assigned programs, walking stakeholders through findings on a regular basis.
Perform continuous improvement activities to improve departmental and/or program capability in areas of inspection, cost of quality, quantitative process control or general process efficiency.
Interface directly with DCMA, ISEA and other customer representatives as required, initiating contact and clarifying requirements as issues arise.
cond_0465.requirements:
Experience operating in an organization with government quality oversight.
Familiarity with FAR/DFAR requirements.
Familiarity and working knowledge of ISO9001 and AS9100 standards.
Current or ability to obtain security clearance.
Experience with Lean and process improvement tools/methods.
Experience with Six Sigma, SPC techniques and PFMEA.
Typically requires a Bachelor's Degree in Engineering or related technical degree, and two (2) years related Quality Assurance experience, or the overall equivalent experience.
Quality experience in a manufacturing or engineering environment.
Prior experience with the management of a Quality Management System.
Familiarity and working knowledge of the ISO 9001 standard.
Strength in planning and time management.
Excellent communication and interpersonal skills.

People usually grow into this role over time as they build experience with quality engineering work.
cond_0626.requirements:
Provide oversight of all aspects of product quality relating to assigned programs including: inspection methods, data collection, data analysis, non-conforming material dispositions, and product/process quality assurance.
Investigate and produce corrective actions meeting on-time submittal and acceptable quality standards for root cause analysis and preventative action effectiveness.
Ensure on-time implementation of corrective actions and verification of preventative action effectiveness.
Coordinate and lead Material Review Board activities.
Gather and report results from weekly and monthly quality metrics for all assigned programs.
Perform continuous improvement activities to improve departmental and/or program capability in areas of inspection, cost of quality, quantitative process control or general process efficiency.
Interface with DCMA, ISEA and other customer representatives as required.
Experience operating in an organization with government quality oversight.
Familiarity with FAR/DFAR requirements.
Familiarity and working knowledge of ISO9001 and AS9100 standards.
Current or ability to obtain security clearance.
Experience with Lean and process improvement tools/methods.
Experience with Six Sigma, SPC techniques and PFMEA.
Typically requires a Bachelor's Degree in Engineering or related technical degree, and two (2) years related Quality Assurance experience, or the overall equivalent experience.
Quality experience in a manufacturing or engineering environment.
Prior experience with the management of a Quality Management System.
Familiarity and working knowledge of the ISO 9001 standard.
Strength in planning and time management.
Excellent communication and interpersonal skills.
cond_0626.encouragement_text: Important: Even if you do not meet all of the qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply.
